title: Fallback unit responsibility
responsibility: Creates an explicitly derived placeholder from a unit’s kind and title when no human responsibility has been declared.

inputs.name: derivedResponsibility.kind
inputs.description: Unit kind used to choose a known purpose phrase; unknown kinds use the kind followed by unit.

inputs.name: derivedResponsibility.title
inputs.description: Unit title inserted unchanged into the placeholder sentence.

outputs.name: derivedResponsibility
outputs.description: Placeholder sentence of the form Owns the title purpose. It names a kind and title only and is not a reviewed description of behavior.
